career_ladder.note: RRB Level-1 (formerly Group 'D') represents the foundational operational workforce of Indian Railways across engineering, mechanical, electrical, signaling, and traffic wings. Through departmental quotas (General Departmental Competitive Examination - GDCE and Limited Departmental Competitive Examination - LDCE), Level-1 employees can advance into supervisory and junior engineering ranks.

exam_scheme.note: RRB Group D (Level-1) recruitment comprises a single-stage Computer Based Test (CBT, 100 marks, 90 minutes) followed by a mandatory qualifying Physical Efficiency Test (PET), Document Verification, and Comprehensive Railway Medical Examination. In CBT, one-third (1/3) of the marks allotted to each question is deducted for each incorrect answer.

financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated at Level 1 entry basic pay (₹18,000) with 58% DA (₹10,440). Track Maintainers receive an additional Risk and Hardship Allowance of ₹2,700 per month (Matrix Level 1). Night Duty and Overtime allowances apply to operational yard staff.
official_perks: Free Railway Passes and Privilege Ticket Orders (PTO) across Indian Railways for employee and family
Full comprehensive medical care in Indian Railway Hospitals and Dispensaries
Risk & Hardship Allowance for track maintenance personnel
Dress/Uniform allowance and NPS retirement pension

competition_benchmarks.note: RRB Group D (Level-1) represents the single largest recruitment drive in global civil employment history. The RRC-01/2019 cycle notified 1,03,769 vacancies, drawing over 1.15 crore registered applicants. The earlier CEN 02/2018 drive filled 62,907 vacancies with over 1.89 crore applicants.
